issues.recommended_change: Only carry scope_status explicitly provided by source inventories; case_index records without scope should contribute no affirmative federal_process label. Preserve the formal-channel flag. This does not change numerical pool counts.

issues.problem: Direct-PDF URL identity strips the entire query, which can collapse distinct versioned PDFs sharing a path if a future row uses query-only versioning. No actual social collision or count change was established.
issues.recommended_change: Retain version-discriminating query fields or require matching bytes/version metadata before merging query-distinguished PDF URLs.
